synopsis: IDIADA provides vehicle-in-the-loop services, including injecting virtual hazards into a real vehicle’s ECU on a track through sensor stimulation [f16108, f406, f540]. With MathWorks, it demonstrated virtual-to-physical correlation of frontal automatic emergency braking for on-road cars on 14 April 2026, using closed-loop virtual sensors, vehicle dynamics and an AEB controller, with production-vehicle proving-ground tests and ISO 18571 correlation metrics [f1761, f1269, f1762]. The demonstration included far more scenario variants than earlier protocol generations but retained proving-ground correlation [f1270, f1764]. This establishes a demonstrated capability, not evidence that a specific vehicle received a rating: the acceptance evidence involved a test house and tool vendor, and no vehicle rating was shown [f1271, f1765]. Capability-building time was not found, and validation time was reported only as a demonstration, leaving the implementation timeline unresolved [f1763].
